description: Source code for the RegionSamplingThread class in Android SurfaceFlinger, handling region-based luminance sampling for display content analysis.

classes.name: RegionSamplingThread
classes.description: Handles region-based luminance sampling for display content analysis, including thread management, listener handling, and screen capture.

classes.name: RegionSamplingThread::EnvironmentTimingTunables
classes.description: Holds configurable timing parameters for region sampling, initialized from system properties.

methods.name: RegionSamplingThread::EnvironmentTimingTunables
methods.description: Constructor that initializes timing parameters from system properties or defaults.

methods.name: RegionSamplingThread::RegionSamplingThread
methods.description: Constructs the sampling thread with specified or default timing tunables.

methods.name: RegionSamplingThread::~RegionSamplingThread
methods.description: Destructor that stops the thread and cleans up.

methods.name: RegionSamplingThread::addListener
methods.description: Adds a listener for a specified sampling area and stop layer ID.

methods.name: RegionSamplingThread::checkForStaleLuma
methods.description: Checks and triggers sampling if luma data is stale.

methods.name: RegionSamplingThread::onCompositionComplete
methods.description: Triggers a sampling operation upon composition completion.

methods.name: RegionSamplingThread::doSample
methods.description: Performs the sampling operation, considering timing constraints and deadlines.

methods.name: RegionSamplingThread::binderDied
methods.description: Handles cleanup when a listener's binder dies.
